problem: The user supplied an App screenshot whose preview was covered by a final Swift.CancellationError message. The prior generic catch published cancellation as an error and never cleared an earlier error on a later successful load.
scope: ModelViewport.swift and its new targeted tests; integrated App tests also verify separately owned memory-pressure, cancellation, thumbnail and store changes. This agent did not operate a phone, restore deleted projects, publish a synthetic fixture into the model library, run AI generation, change a model/asset pack, sign, upload or release.

fix.viewLifecycle: Load Entity using a SwiftUI-owned .task keyed by URL and explicit retry ID; RealityView make only configures the camera and update mounts the ready entity.
fix.requestOwnership: A cancelled task cannot enter and supersede newer work. Request IDs protect success and error publication from stale completions.
fix.cancellation: Swift cancellation and its NSError bridge produce a paused/cancelled state, without a final error overlay. A disappearing view does not start a background retry; reappearance receives a new view task.
fix.genuineFailure: Real asset errors remain visible with an explicit Reload preview action. New attempts clear old errors.
fix.geometryAndFiles: Existing 0.65/longest preview fit, orbit interaction, source URLs and AR/export files are preserved.

independentReadOnlyReview.scope: Source review of task lifetime, stale-ID guards, entity identity/removal, camera target clearing and unchanged normalization; review alone was not device or final pixel evidence.

finalVerification.selection: ThreeLiveStudioTests (all App unit tests, no UI-test target)

skip.reason: Real iPhone inference benchmark; simulator measurements are not accepted.
skip.scope: Not counted as successful AI generation or physical-device acceptance.

actualPreviewFixture.source: New synthetic box exported by the unmodified native ThreeLiveNative USDZ exporter into a private temporary test directory, removed after the test. No prior user project was restored.
actualPreviewFixture.loadedBy: Actual ModelViewport view-owned task with the real Entity(contentsOf:) loader
actualPreviewFixture.observed: The native box front face is visibly rendered in green against the black RealityView background, without a cancellation or failed-preview overlay.

earlierIntegratedRun.observedCause: Crash traces show libc++ basic_string(nullptr) in mlx::core::metal::Device::Device. Three unload tests entered Stream.gpu via QwenEngine.unload although no model had loaded; two older cancellation tests entered Memory.activeMemory via AppMemorySnapshot.current. This was distinct from RealityKit preview, whose seven tests passed.
earlierIntegratedRun.subsequentRootOwnedFix: OS-only memory snapshots, unloaded-runtime guards and asynchronous guarded reclaim avoid initializing MLX GPU just to measure/release an idle runtime; later full regression is the final result above.

limits: The exact phone event that cancelled the original RealityView make load was not identified by this Simulator run.
No physical-device preview, AI success/save, stop latency, memory-pressure quality, cold hosted download, offline journey or TestFlight delivery acceptance is established here.
The displayed fixture is newly generated native test geometry, not an AI model and not a replacement for any deleted user project.
Thumbnail tests cover the service/store contracts; this preview capture is not a complete phone model-library thumbnail journey.
The isolated SI/scale UI and assembly candidates remain unpromoted and held.
